description: Scrapped Airbus A320 bought for Rs 1.4 crore from a Bengaluru company, reassembled and opened as the Highfly aircraft restaurant in Vadodara on 25 Oct 2021, capacity 102 (Arunachal24, NDTV, India Today, Oct 2021).
